label: Q-27
title: NFTBonfire is unpausable at deploy (pauser defaults to address(0)) and pausing NFTMinterV2 does not stop bonfire burns, so until setPauser + Pauser.register(bonfire) land, the global incident stop does not reach the burn/Antimatter-mint path (the owner's setRatePerDay(0) one-tx stop remains available)
borderlineNote: QA vs Low. Classed QA. The lack of a pauser does not remove a safe cap sequence: setRatePerDay(0) is a one-tx owner stop that blocks burns and keeps the pot, and setPauser(self)+pause() is also open to the owner (see classifierCorrection). What remains is a documented operational gap: the global Pauser does not reach the bonfire until setPauser + Pauser.register land, and story-053 L102/L21/L128 already state this and assign it to the phStaging2 follow-up. Re-rate trigger (not applied): re-rate to Low if the phStaging2 deploy story omits setPauser + Pauser.register(bonfire).

description: pauser is unset at construction (onlyPauser L74-77 reverts for everyone until setPauser), and the global Pauser can reach NFTBonfire only after setPauser(globalPauser) AND Pauser.register(bonfire). NFTMinterV2.burn has no pause check (NFTMinterV2.sol:341-345), so NFTMinterV2's pause does not cover this path.
impact: During an incident the global Pauser does not stop bonfire burns/AM mints; the owner's remaining stop is setRatePerDay(0), which preserves (does not forfeit) the pot. No user funds at risk.

assetImpact: None directly. During an incident, the global Pauser does not stop bonfire burns or AM mints until it is wired. The owner keeps an immediate stop (setRatePerDay(0)).

sanitizerSeverityNote: On its own this is story-documented (story-053 L102 'NFTBonfire's own pause is the only stop'; L21/L128 assign Pauser registration to the phStaging2 follow-up), which leans QA. It is kept as a distinct footgun because of the interaction a competent owner would not expect: without a pauser, the only way to cap a large pot is setMaxPayout on a live contract, which DEDUP-001/CODE-001 shows is front-runnable, and an owner who pauses 'the NFT system' via the global Pauser leaves bonfire burns and Antimatter mints running. Flagged for review; severity-classifier to decide Low vs QA.
facetReconciliation: Facet (a) 'pausing NFTMinterV2 does not stop bonfire burns' reconciled to existing ledger L-04 674c799b2058 (still-open, lastSeenRun bumped); not re-filed here.
classifierCorrection: DEDUP-004 overstates the loss of a safe cap sequence. setRatePerDay(0) is a one-tx owner-only stop: it checkpoints the pot (preserved), and burn() then reverts NFTBonfire__BurningDisabled (L98). The owner can then setMaxPayout(cap) with no burn able to front-run it, and re-enable the rate. The owner can also setPauser(self) and pause() (two txs; atomic if the owner is a Safe batching them). Both safe sequences exist without the global Pauser; only the pot standing when the first tx lands can escape, exactly as with pause-first.
